classes.description: The player has no verified official team-news entry, so availability stays unknown. Absence of an injury report is not evidence of fitness.
classes.label: No verified team-news entry
classes.reason: The curated ledger has no official AFC entry for this player.

resolving_source.label: Aberdeen FC official team news
resolving_source.note: Only an official club entry can change the availability state.

classes.description: The licensed provider declares injuries false, so its injury endpoint is not used as team news. The register cannot name a player from it.
classes.label: Provider injury feed is unavailable
classes.reason: provider_declares_injuries_false.

classes.description: The move is confirmed but no public fee was disclosed. The register keeps the fee undisclosed and does not turn an inferred range into an amount.
classes.label: Fee not disclosed
classes.reason: No public disclosure accompanied the transfer.

resolving_source.label: Official announcement or public season record
resolving_source.note: Only a disclosed or reported figure with a public source is added.

classes.description: Loan duration, recall and purchase-obligation terms are not in the licensed feed unless a public announcement confirms them.
classes.label: Loan end, recall and obligation terms
classes.reason: The provider transfer row does not carry the terms.

resolving_source.label: Official club announcement
resolving_source.note: A confirmed term is curated; an unconfirmed term stays unknown.

classes.description: A disclosed headline fee does not disclose instalments, add-ons, agent payments or solidarity contributions.
classes.label: Instalments, add-ons and agent terms
classes.reason: These terms are not made public.

classes.description: The public record does not carry contract length, wages, release clauses or agent fees, so none is inferred or estimated.
classes.label: Contract length, wages and release clauses
classes.reason: Not in the licensed feed and not publicly disclosed.

classes.description: A clause exists but at least one required input is missing: an evidenced percentage, an allowed basis, a public subsequent fee or the original fee for a profit-basis clause.
classes.label: Sell-on receipt not computable
classes.reason: One or more required public inputs are missing.

resolving_source.label: Public clause and subsequent-fee evidence
resolving_source.note: A receipt is computed only when every required input is evidenced.

classes.description: The league is searchable but the provider returns no player season statistics, so no player from it can be ranked.
classes.label: League without player season statistics
classes.reason: No provider player-season rows for the league.

resolving_source.label: Licensed provider player statistics
resolving_source.note: The league is labelled, never filled with zero-strength players.

classes.description: Possession, progressive passes, carries, pressures, aerial wins, crosses, xG/xA and event coordinates are not supplied by the licensed feed.
classes.label: Advanced event data is not in the feed
classes.reason: Not in the licensed feed.

classes.description: The value model waits for enough public-source fee anchors. Until the gate passes, the value index is not a GBP valuation.
classes.label: Value model is not fitted
classes.reason: Public-source anchor register below the model gate.

resolving_source.label: Public-source fee anchors
resolving_source.note: More disclosed or reported fees are the only route to a fitted model.

classes.description: No starting-XI grid or observed role covers the player, so the role stays unknown rather than being inferred from a generic position label.
classes.label: Role not observed
classes.reason: No observed starting-XI role.

resolving_source.label: Observed starting-XI grid
resolving_source.note: A role is added only from an observed grid, never guessed.

classes.description: No explicit public statement or licensed attribute confirms the preferred foot, so the attribute stays unknown.
classes.label: Preferred foot not verified
classes.reason: No explicit statement in the covered sources.

resolving_source.label: Explicit public statement
resolving_source.note: An explicit statement is required; a guess is not accepted.

classes.description: The provider has no current-season statistics for the player. The row is labelled unavailable and is never filled with zeroes.
classes.label: Player statistics unavailable
classes.reason: No provider rows for the covered scope.

resolving_source.label: Licensed provider player statistics
resolving_source.note: A later provider row resolves the gap.

classes.description: The former player's current or last-known club is not in the covered provider record.
classes.label: Current or last-known club unknown
classes.reason: No current-season provider row and no curated public record.

resolving_source.label: Public transfer or club record
resolving_source.note: A club is added only with a public record.

classes.description: Earlier transfer windows are curated from public records and are not audited to the same depth as the recent four.
classes.label: Pre-2024-25 transfer windows are curated partial
classes.reason: Historical register coverage is partial.

resolving_source.label: Public season records
resolving_source.note: A window is audited only when its rows can be checked against a source.

classes.description: The licensed league migration does not yet pass its fixture-count and team-match-stat gate, so football-data remains the active league source.
classes.label: League migration gate is failing
classes.reason: The provider gate failed at the last check.

resolving_source.label: Passing provider gate
resolving_source.note: Migration is enabled only when the gate passes.

classes.description: Possession is not supplied for the covered fixtures, so it is not used in the style read and never shown as zero.
classes.label: Possession is not in the feed
classes.reason: Not in the licensed feed.

classes.description: A name that does not resolve to the former-player register, the scouted pool or the provider profile search is not promoted to a target.
classes.label: Rumour name outside the gazetteer
classes.reason: No supported identity match.

classes.description: fitba does not know the club's internal models, valuations or private conversations. Only public proxies are shown.
classes.label: Boardroom intent and internal valuations
classes.reason: Not public.

classes.description: The needs board describes role profiles, not transfer targets. Fees and wages are not public and are never invented.
classes.label: Needs fees, wages and targets
classes.reason: The club's budget and wage structure are not public.

owner_note: Unknown is a published state, not zero. The register records gaps in the public record and the source that could close them. It does not request data from the club and does not treat a missing field as a zero.
